sources.title: Changchun Engley Automobile Industry Co., Ltd. — company presentation
sources.effective_period: Company presentation dated 2023-11-29; line establishment described from 2013.
sources.note: States that Laitwei was established in September 2013, introduced a complete European production line, and develops and produces automotive lightweight composite SYMALITE.

sources.title: Changchun Engley Automobile Industry Co., Ltd. — company presentation
sources.note: Directly states that the Laitwei production line is one of five worldwide and the only SymaLITE lightweight-composite production line in Asia.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
Research stopped after the available tool-call limit was reached; current independent verification of the Asia-wide production-line denominator remains unresolved.
The exact exclusivity wording is supported by an official issuer presentation, but no independent enumeration of SymaLITE production lines in Asia was found.
The evidence is dated 2023-11-29 and does not independently establish that the exclusivity remains true today.
